notes.title: 🎯 Version 1.2: Discover New Endings and New Achievements 🏆
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

Based on your exploration reports, we have enacted the latest update (version 1.2) for The Anomalous Hours. We've made the following astounding discoveries:

📹 Five New Endings: We've confirmed reports from seekers that there are 5 new endings to The Anomalous Hour. If you want to get out, we advise you to find these endings. But be warned: not all endings are happy endings.

👹 New Behavior for Anomalies: We've detected a change in behavior for two anomalies: The Gruesome and The Stalker. We advise you to practice utmost caution when interacting with these anomalies.

🏆 New Achievements: Tied to the new endings, there are achievements you can get by discovering these endings. 

Thank you for your tireless support and feedback, seekers. We wish for your safe return from your next foray into the Anomalous Hour. Remember, you can take a man out of the Anomalous Hour, but you can't take The Anomalous Hour out of the man.

notes.title: 📸 Update Announcement: Version 1.1c Now Live! 📸
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

We are ready to unveil the latest update (Version 1.1c) for The Anomalous Hours, based on your invaluable exploration data and reports. Here's what's new:

📷 Improved Camera Movement Sensitivity: We've fine-tuned the camera controls to provide smoother, more responsive movement, to better facilitate your expedition during the Anomalous Hours.

🐛 Bug Fixed (Walkgoing and Running Speed): We've resolved a potentially anomalous bug affecting walking and running speeds, ensuring more fluid and consistent in-game movements.

🎮 Updated Game Props: We have updated several items around the station to match closer with expected baseline reality.  

🔧 Minor Bug Fixes: We've combed through your reports and addressed several minor bugs to provide as much stability as possible during your excursions.

Thank you for your tireless support and feedback, seekers. We wish for your safe return from your next foray into the Anomalous Hour.
